page_title: JUV 1-1 LEC | Juventus v Lecce 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+5' The ball rebounds to Lois Openda (Juventus) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
90+4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
90+3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+3' Filip Kostic (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Juventus get a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' Jonathan David (Juventus) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Wladimiro Falcone guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
88' Lois Openda (Juventus) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
87' Lois Openda (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
87' Filip Kostic (Juventus) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.
86' Jonathan David (Juventus) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
86' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
83' Substitution. Weston McKennie makes his way off the pitch and Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
81' Here is a change. Lameck Banda is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
78' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jonathan David (Juventus) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
77' A substitution has been made. Manuel Locatelli goes off and Lois Openda (Juventus) comes on.
76' Jonathan David (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
74' Filip Kostic (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
73' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
72' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jonathan David.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo Veiga (Lecce) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' It will be a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is ready to enter the pitch as Khephren Thuram walks off.
69' The substitution is prepared. Filip Kostic (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Cambiaso.
68' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Santiago Pierotti will be replaced by Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).
68' Francesco Camarda will be replaced by Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

66' Jonathan David (Juventus) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot low into the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and doesn't have to move to stop the effort.
65' Jonathan David (Juventus) is going to take the penalty!
65' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Juventus!
63' Referee Giuseppe Collu makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Juventus. Let’s see what happens!
63' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jonathan David (Juventus) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
61' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Youssef Maleh (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
58' The linesman signals that Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

57' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
54' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
53' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Weston McKennie (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:1.
49' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
49' An attempted cross from Lameck Banda (Lecce) is cleared.
48' Lecce take a short corner kick.
48' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Luciano Spalletti probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Francisco Conceicao. He is replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
46' 1 - 0 Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Lameck Banda (Lecce) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) makes a slide tackle, but referee Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
44' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
43' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) is able to continue to play.
41' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
39' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
36' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
34' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle after Weston McKennie (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
32' The game has come to an end for Matias Perez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
32' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
32' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is about to take a corner kick.

31' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.

29' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
28' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
28' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
27' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
26' Jonathan David (Juventus) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
25' A cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
23' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) makes a strong challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.

20' Fine attempt! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
19' Excellent touch by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
17' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

17' Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
16' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes it short.

15' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.

15' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
14' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
14' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
13' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
11' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
11' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
10' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
9' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.

7' A great touch by Jonathan David (Juventus)! He jumped and aimed a precise header at the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper showed his skill and denied him as the ball bounced off his gloves and rattled the post.
7' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) works the corner short.

7' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' A cross into the box from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is cleared.

4' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a short corner kick.

4' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.

3' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Wladimiro Falcone guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
2' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Juventus will kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu will referee today's match.
